body: On the back: “late Wednesday, emerald flecks in the cab after the crop trial. the chickens stopped moving. Later, the back road closed.”
title: Cab note — late Wednesday
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the emerald flecks while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: A crossing marked in pencil
body: The driver said the animals had to wait until the officials finished counting cars. He asked whether the trailer counted as one vehicle or several lives. They copied the plate and waved the empty truck ahead.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
